title: Dragons Air Balloons
description: This pack is an addon to Happy Ghast Baloon. The harness textures have been replaced with Chick Watermelon, Morton Balloon, etc.
body:
# Happy Air Balloons for your minecraft world!
__This texturepack changes the appearance of the ghasts and their equipment. Now, instead of giant squids, balloons will hover over your base.__

__The set includes equipment for all occasions: for base decoration, research purposes, cosplays for real life and in-game battles___


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This texture pack is an addition to the texture pack "Happy Ghast Balloon". My pack is based on textures from it (so download it too)( https://modrinth.com/project/vFMdwmDW ).

</details>





I would like to hear from you about your harness variants(please note that some variants may not match the package style).
